intent.purpose: Break enemy control of the Kārsava–Malnava corridor and open the A13 for follow-on forces.
intent.method: Isolate corridor strongpoints through reconnaissance, interdiction, and targeted raids before committing the platoon to decisive action.
intent.endState: The A13 corridor is secure, enemy maneuver forces cannot interfere, and Task Force Lantern retains combat power for follow-on operations.

mission.title: Silent Lantern
mission.situation: Enemy control of the northern A13 corridor depends on the fictional Grebņeva Relay, but its security posture and approaches are unknown. Task Force Lantern must establish observation without triggering a general engagement.

intent.purpose: Confirm the Grebņeva Relay disposition and identify a viable approach for a follow-on raid.
intent.method: Infiltrate a small reconnaissance element through Salnava farmland, establish observation in the Nūmerne Heights, and map enemy security and emissions while avoiding decisive contact.
intent.endState: Relay strength, EW assets, and access routes are confirmed; the reconnaissance element returns with at least 75% strength; enemy alert does not rise materially.

metttc.Mission: Reconnoiter the Nūmerne Heights and Grebņeva Relay; do not become decisively engaged.
metttc.Enemy: Patrols, probable EW team, possible small UAS. QRF location unknown.
metttc.Terrain & Weather: Low wooded ridges, lakes, drainage, and wet fields; overcast before dawn; reduced long-range observation.
metttc.Troops & Support: Recommended: 4–6 troops, one UAS, optional precision-fire allocation.
metttc.Civil Considerations: Farm workers enter western fields near dawn. Avoid compromise and property damage.

ocoka.Observation & Fields of Fire: The Nūmerne ridges overlook eastern approaches; the relay compound has clear arcs across nearby fields.
ocoka.Cover & Concealment: Woodlots, drainage cuts, and field boundaries provide concealed bounds from Salnava.
ocoka.Obstacles: Wet ground slows vehicles; suspected wire on compound perimeter.
ocoka.Key Terrain: Nūmerne eastern treeline; Salnava field boundaries; Grebņeva southern service approach.
ocoka.Avenues of Approach: West through woodland and farmland is concealed but civilian-sensitive; the A13 approach is fast and exposed.

objectives.text: Observe the Grebņeva Relay for two uninterrupted turns
Identify EW antenna and security element
Exit at least 75% of the force from friendly edge

history.summary: FOB Mežvidi established southwest of the A13 corridor. Enemy retains Kārsava and the Malnava junction.
